objective: Add a monthly PDF export capability for customer reports with async job processing, in-process job store, i18n labels (EN/DE), and three new API endpoints, reusing existing report queries.
in_scope: In-process job store with state machine (pending -> running -> done/failed) and job_id generation
POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf endpoint that enqueues a job and returns 202 with job_id
GET /jobs/{id} polling endpoint returning job status and state
GET /jobs/{id}/download endpoint returning PDF bytes when job is done
PDF export service using vendored pdflib_shim, one page per report, consuming report rows from app/queries.py
i18n label module with EN and DE translations for PDF labels, selected by lang field (default en)
Vendoring pdflib_shim module as a real file in the repo
Unit tests for the new job store, PDF export service, and API endpoints

out_of_scope.item: Historical archive or retention policy for old exports
out_of_scope.reason: Explicitly excluded by task; adds storage and lifecycle management out of scope

frozen_assumptions.statement: In-process job queue is sufficient at this scale; no external message broker needed
frozen_assumptions.rationale: Task explicitly says in-process is fine at this scale; the fixture has no job infrastructure and the repo is stdlib-only

frozen_assumptions.statement: pdflib_shim.py will be provided as a 40-line wrapper by the platform team; the plan treats vendoring it as a real task
frozen_assumptions.rationale: README Platform notes state this explicitly; stdlib cannot render PDFs

frozen_assumptions.statement: i18n covers PDF labels only (headers, column names), not full UI strings
frozen_assumptions.rationale: Task says labels in the PDF must be available in EN and DE; no UI layer exists in this service

frozen_architecture.decision: Job store is an in-process dict-based store with a background thread worker; state machine: pending -> running -> done | failed
frozen_architecture.rationale: No job infrastructure exists; in-process is the minimum that satisfies async semantics; background thread runs one job at a time

frozen_architecture.decision: export_pdf renders the single report named by report_id (one page) using report_with_rows; the endpoint POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf exports one report per job
frozen_architecture.rationale: Matches frozen contract C2 (export_pdf takes report_id, not a list); the endpoint URL /reports/{id}/export-pdf confirms one-report-per-export; input.md requirement 4 'one page per report' is satisfied by rendering the single report as one PDF page

shared_contracts.spec: JobStore interface: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id (str); get(job_id) -> Job | None where Job = {id, customer_id, report_id, lang, status: pending|running|done|failed, result: bytes|None, error: str|None, created_at: str}. Status transitions: pending->running (worker picks up), running->done (PDF generated), running->failed (exception). No other transitions allowed.

PdfExportService interface: export_pdf(customer_id: str, report_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes. Fetches report data via app/queries.report_with_rows (never reads _REPORTS directly). Uses pdflib_shim to render one page per report. Returns raw PDF bytes. Raises PdfExportError on failure. lang must be 'en' or 'de'; unknown lang raises ValueError.

POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf: body {lang: str (optional, default 'en')} -> 202 {job_id: str}. 404 if report_id unknown. 400 if lang not in {en, de}. GET /jobs/{id} -> 200 {job_id, status, result_available: bool, error: str|None}. 404 if job unknown. GET /jobs/{id}/download -> 200 (application/pdf bytes) if done, 409 if not done, 404 if unknown.

integration_seams.description: API endpoints interact with JobStore: POST creates a job, GET reads job state, download reads job result
Job worker invokes PdfExportService: worker picks up pending job, calls export_pdf, stores result or error

acceptance.description: POST /reports/r1/export-pdf returns 202 with a job_id string
acceptance.positive_case: POST with report_id=r1 returns HTTP 202 and body contains job_id field with a non-empty string
acceptance.negative_case: POST with report_id=nope returns HTTP 404 with error field
acceptance.failure_behavior: POST with lang=fr returns HTTP 400 with error field

acceptance.positive_case: After POST, GET /jobs/{job_id} returns status pending or running; after completion, returns status done with result_available true
acceptance.failure_behavior: If job fails, status is failed with error string populated

acceptance.description: GET /jobs/{id}/download returns valid PDF bytes when done
acceptance.positive_case: After job completes, download returns HTTP 200 with content-type application/pdf and body starts with %PDF
acceptance.negative_case: Download before job completes returns HTTP 409
acceptance.failure_behavior: Download for unknown job returns HTTP 404

acceptance.description: PDF labels are in the requested language
acceptance.positive_case: Export with lang=de produces PDF with German label text; lang=en (default) produces English labels
acceptance.negative_case: Export with lang=fr returns 400 before job creation
acceptance.failure_behavior: Unknown lang in i18n module raises ValueError

acceptance.description: Existing CSV export tests remain green
acceptance.positive_case: pytest tests/test_export.py runs and all tests pass
acceptance.negative_case: N/A — this is a regression check
acceptance.failure_behavior: If CSV tests break, the PDF export changes leaked into the CSV path

constraints.rule: All report data access must go through app/queries.py functions; no direct import of _REPORTS or _CUSTOMERS
Python 3.11 stdlib only; no external packages. pdflib_shim is vendored, not installed
Follow existing code patterns: dataclasses for models, framework-agnostic handler functions, type hints with __future__ annotations

Whether to support additional languages beyond EN/DE
